    Dispose of DownloadManagerInterface in onDestroy.
    
    This fixes a bug introduced in cf27461bfaa78798252103345b1c14528bb4828c. Prior
    to that commit, the DMI was bound to the Application object and there was no
    reason to unregister the download receiver. Now that it's bound to the main
    activity, there is.

Commit:     Barend Garvelink <bgarvelink@xebia.com>
CommitDate: Sun Oct 16 12:37:12 2016 +0200

    Move all initialization into MainActivity.
    
    Remove the SebApp class, because the Firebase Crash Reporter relies on a child
    process. Any initialization happening in the Application class causes a world
    of hurt once child processes are in play.
